situation: Customer had low feature adoption 60 days after onboarding
play: Skipped the admin and ran a 'feature spotlight' session directly with power users using their own data to show real before/after impact
outcome: Adoption jumped from 8% to 64% in 30 days

situation: Champion left the company mid-contract with no handoff
play: Identified the internal 'shadow champion' who had been quietly involved in implementation but wasn't the official sponsor. Ran an executive re-intro session within 48 hours.
outcome: Maintained renewal and expanded ARR by 15% at renewal

situation: Customer gave a low NPS score (5/10) at QBR with no explanation
play: Paused the QBR agenda entirely, asked the stakeholder to walk through their top 3 frustrations live, and built a 30-day action plan on the spot with owners and dates
outcome: NPS improved to 8/10 at next QBR and customer agreed to be a reference
